description: Optimize and convert a 3D model to GLB using DGG RapidPipeline on EKS.
inputInstructions:
Optimizes and decimates a 3D model with RapidPipeline on Amazon EKS and outputs glTF Binary (.glb). Requires a licensed RapidPipeline deployment. Select the source model as the input file.

This pipeline reads no asset or file metadata — optimization settings come from this template.
